photos.story: Berlin changes fastest in ordinary corners. This view of Institut für Geschwulstforschung catches Spandau in 1932, so I would look for what is temporary, practical, or newly built.

photos.title: Radrennfahrer Bruno Demke
photos.story: A useful Rewind habit is to separate the famous name from the actual scene. At Radrennfahrer Bruno Demke, the people and the street edge are the better clue to Steglitz-Zehlendorf in 1906.
photos.commonsTitle: File:Bundesarchiv Bild 183-2008-0714-501, Berlin, Radrennfahrer Bruno Demke.jpg

photos.title: Berlin-Tempelhof, Ankunft der Ozeanflieger
photos.story: This scene sits between a city people recognise and the city that came before it. Berlin-Tempelhof, Ankunft der Ozeanflieger keeps the clue local: look at Tempelhof-Schoneberg before you guess the year.
